text:
navin: Heads-up — seeing sustained drop in batch utilization on rtv-prod over the last ~2h. Kernel selector is flipping to `generic_fp16` a lot more, and KV cache hitrate fell ~7%. Posting telemetry snippets here to triage.

olivia: Link to the grafana panel? want to eyeball the p95s and queue depth.

navin: https://grafana.redwood/boards/rtv-batching?panel=queue_util — primary charts: batch_utilization, queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, kernel_flip_rate, kv_hitrate. Quick PromQL I ran: `sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (node)` and `sum(avg_over_time(batch_size[5m])) by (cluster)` — shows lower avg batch_size.

aj: Could be the kernel selector tweak I pushed last night (rollout @ 21:12 UTC). I rolled it back for the canary group at 22:05 but maybe rollout still in effect for some cohorts.

maria: We also had a change to token budget enforcement for mobile clients earlier today — increased budget cap from 1024->2048 for a small client subset. That can increase queueing pressure and cause kernel choices to prefer shorter-opt kernels.

perf-bot: nightly-profiler finished: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/2026-03-17/rtv-prod-kernel-traces.tar.gz (size: 420MB). Contains traces for kernel-switch events and KV miss hot paths.

liam: Quick observations from the dashboard: queue_depth_p95 jumped from 12->38 concurrently with client token_budget spike. tokens/sec per node increased ~18%, but batch_utilization dropped — suggests more 'long' requests blocking microbatch formation.

carol: I can add a focused dashboard row: batch_utilization (p50/p95), queue_depth (p50/p95), tokens_per_sec, kernel_flip_rate (per node), kv_hitrate. Also panel for first_token_latency and kernel_selection_latency. Will include these queries: 
```
# batch_utilization
sum(rate(batch_active_tokens[1m])) / sum(rate(batch_capacity_tokens[1m]))

# kernel_flip_rate
sum(rate(kernel_selector_flips[5m])) by (node) / sum(rate(kernel_select_attempts[5m])) by (node)

# kv_hitrate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[1m]))
```

navin: Great. Action items: (1) Carol add dashboard and a temporary alert: kernel_flip_rate > 0.03 sustained 5m, (2) Maria revert mobile token cap for the client cohort to 1024, (3) Aj confirm rollback fully propagated for all clusters, (4) Liam capture a pcap of ingress for suspect clients. I'll attach profiler extract and a sample request trace.

aj: I'll run `kubectl rollout status` across the selector deployments and post statuses. If any remaining pods have the new selector I'll force a restart.

maria: Reverting the token cap now for that cohort and will report when change is live (ETA ~3m).

liam: Starting tcpdump on the ingress nodes for the flagged client cidrs, saving to s3://redwood-debug/rtv/ingress-cap/2923456789.pcap.gz

perf-bot: alert-suppress:kernel-flip-rate created for 1h to avoid noisy duplicates (owner: carol).

navin: Thanks — let's reconvene in 20m after the changes. If anyone sees kernel_flip_rate > 0.05 or kv_hitrate drop > 10% escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
